title: Notice of Intent to Award a BPA Call Order
agency_path: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.FOREST SERVICE.MONONGAHELA NATIONAL FOREST
detail_text: THIS IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. This is a notice of intent to award a competitive BPA Call Order against the Land Management Integrated Resources (LMIR) Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA). Work includes but is not limited to - perform mowing, trimming, and general grounds maintenance at the Monongahela National Forest Greenbrier Ranger District administrative compound and associated government residences located in Bartow, WV. This is not a solicitation. This synopsis notification of intent to award a BPA Call order does not constitute a request for proposals or submission of any information in response to this notification. The LMIR BPA has a continuous pre-solicitation sharing that contractors may look into joining the BPA at any point in time while the BPA is active by reaching out to the POC on Solicitation 12363N23Q4023.
